decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct sources regarding awards received by Hideo Kojima. Document 2 (D2S14, D2S18) explicitly states he received the 'Academy Fellowship Award' (also referred to as 'BAFTA Fellowship' in titles, but the specific award name is Academy Fellowship Award). Document 1 (D1S16) describes a fictional scenario where he is conferred the title 'Knight of the Order of the Sword'. Per the instruction to preserve distinct valid referents and complementary answers found in the source text without inventing constraints or dismissing one due to factual reality vs fiction (as both are asserted in the text), both are included. Other candidates like 'BAFTA Fellowship' (C2) are variations of C0, and 'Order of the Sword' (C5) is part of the full title in C1.
